subtitle: Vanilla tables turned into shared storage for both players.
description: Turns existing Stranded Deep tables into full storage while keeping the native radial interface, adding denser stacks and separate safe persistence for the contents.
features: Works on the game's existing tables instead of adding a separate construction type.
WOOD_TABLE, PLANK_TABLE and CORRUGATED_TABLE each use 7 storage slots.
Table storage uses denser capacity by multiplying the vanilla stack size by 3 inside the table only.
P1 and P2 in local split-screen access the same shared table contents.
Uses the native radial storage UI, including the game's normal Push, Pop, Open/Close and gamepad interaction.
Contents are stored in a separate sidecar keyed by the stable ReferenceId of the table.
Persistence uses the game's own SlotStorage.Save() payload rather than a custom hand-written item list.
Stored contents are represented visually on the tabletop.

faq.question: How many slots does a table have?
faq.answer: Supported WOOD_TABLE, PLANK_TABLE and CORRUGATED_TABLE objects use 7 slots, which is the practical limit chosen for the native radial UI.

faq.question: Are stack sizes increased everywhere?
faq.answer: No. The x3 multiplier applies only inside the table storage.

faq.question: Do the two split-screen players get separate table inventories?
faq.answer: No. Both players access the same physical table and the same SlotStorage.

faq.question: Does the mod rewrite the vanilla save JSON?
faq.answer: Table contents are stored separately in a sidecar while using the game's own SlotStorage serialization payload.

faq.question: Why is storage keyed by ReferenceId instead of position?
faq.answer: Tables can move. ReferenceId keeps the identity of the same construction object when its coordinates change.
